name: Cody Brocious (Daeken)
biography: Cody is the Head of Hacker Education at HackerOne where he dedicates his time to teaching hackers to be more effective and empowered. A reverse engineer and software developer with well over a decade of experience. Cody is also the lead instructor for Hacker101, a free course for web security.
